nodes.label: Clean Architecture Layering (Repository→Service→Hook→Component)
nodes.rationale: Eksperimen arsitektur untuk memvalidasi pola clean layering di React SPA yang bisa dipakai ulang di project React lain.

nodes.label: PageHeader Convention (Judul Halaman)
nodes.rationale: Sebelumnya tidak konsisten (beda margin/wrapper antar halaman list), dirapikan jadi satu komponen PageHeader.

nodes.label: Why No Controller/API Layer
nodes.rationale: SPA murni, BaaS Supabase menghilangkan kebutuhan SSR/API routes karena tidak ada kebutuhan SEO/first-paint server-side untuk aplikasi internal.

nodes.label: Repository Layer Swappable for Future Backend
nodes.rationale: Frontend's Repository layer kept swappable so a future Go backend can replace Supabase calls with minimal disruption to the Testing Context.
nodes.norm_label: repository layer swappable for future backend

nodes.label: MySQL mysql_native_password auth plugin choice
nodes.rationale: MySQL 8.4 defaults to caching_sha2_password which requires TLS or RSA key exchange go-sql-driver doesn't negotiate automatically; forcing mysql_native_password matches typical existing VPS MySQL and avoids handshake errors in local dev.

nodes.label: React Query + Supabase Realtime Data Freshness (E14)
nodes.rationale: Fixed staleness bug where ProjectDetailPage's module-level tabDataCache had no way to know when TestRunResultDetailPage completed a run, causing stale views until manual refresh.
nodes.norm_label: react query + supabase realtime data freshness (e14)

nodes.label: Entity Code Auto-Generate mechanism (next_entity_code)
nodes.rationale: Race-safe via single insert...on conflict do update...returning statement; trigger only fills code when empty/null so user-entered codes are never overwritten.

nodes.label: Test Management Workflow design rationale
nodes.rationale: Test Case never stores results (v1 stored last_result directly and re-runs overwrote it); Test Run creates new session each execution; completion is manual but progress always computed on-the-fly; Issue is N:M to Test Result so repeated failures link to existing issue instead of duplicating.

nodes.label: Test Suite Library, Import CSV, RBAC Field (E17)
nodes.norm_label: test suite library, import csv, rbac field (e17)

nodes.label: CSV Import instead of xlsx dependency
nodes.rationale: xlsx (SheetJS) npm package has high-severity prototype pollution + ReDoS vulnerability with no fix; CSV parser written manually (RFC 4180 minimal) avoids the external dependency.
nodes.norm_label: csv import instead of xlsx dependency

nodes.label: users/profiles Identity Split
nodes.rationale: Old profiles conflated authenticated account (email must stay private) with public identity, so it can't live on the same row joined into public pages (Design Principle 1).

nodes.label: Organization-readiness without building organizations
nodes.rationale: Give projects a polymorphic owner_type/owner_id now even though only 'user' is populated, so orgs can be added later as a zero-downtime additive change without breaking existing project rows.

nodes.label: API Boundary Proposal for future Go backend
nodes.norm_label: api boundary proposal for future go backend

nodes.label: Public Profile Rescoped to Functional Identity Only
nodes.rationale: Original brainstorm framed public profiles as GitHub-style portfolio; Constitution rejects Social Network category, so profile scoped down to username+display name+avatar only, kept for Phase 6 as invite-target-picker UI not a portfolio feature.
nodes.norm_label: public profile rescoped to functional identity only

nodes.label: Sequence (urutan eksekusi) di Test Plan
nodes.rationale: Sengaja tidak dibuat entity Test Suite terpisah untuk sequence - urutan cukup jadi atribut baris relasi Test Plan-Test Case; sequence panduan workflow bukan pembatas eksekusi.

nodes.rationale: Storage adapter interface allows switching providers without changing service/UI - starts with Supabase Storage, slot prepared for internal backend upload adapter.

nodes.label: Simplicity First principle
nodes.rationale: Every screen should remain understandable by a new user within minutes; simple is preferred over powerful.

nodes.label: Technology Independence principle
nodes.rationale: Business domain must remain independent from any specific backend technology; Supabase used for rapid dev, no business rule should depend directly on it, future Go backend migration should require minimal changes.

nodes.label: Feature Acceptance Rule
nodes.rationale: If more than two of the five acceptance questions answer No, reject the feature.

nodes.label: Decision: Full history instead of last-result
nodes.rationale: Old model stored PASS/FAIL directly on test_plan_cases.last_result which got overwritten on re-run; new model creates a new Test Run each execution session so release-to-release history is preserved.
nodes.norm_label: decision: full history instead of last-result

nodes.label: Theme mode switch inline script (dark/light PrimeReact theme)
nodes.norm_label: theme mode switch inline script (dark/light primereact theme)

nodes.label: Results always live on TestResult, never TestCase/TestPlanCase
nodes.rationale: Keeps the test template (what should be tested) permanently separate from execution history so re-running never overwrites or corrupts prior results, and history stays immutable.
nodes.norm_label: results always live on testresult, never testcase/testplancase

nodes.label: TestRun progress always derived live from TestResult, never stored
nodes.rationale: Avoids a stale, manually-updated progress number that could drift from the actual underlying test results.
nodes.norm_label: testrun progress always derived live from testresult, never stored

nodes.label: Tester must be a registered user, resolved via Profile
nodes.rationale: Prevents free-text tester names so accountability and identity resolution stay consistent and traceable.
nodes.norm_label: tester must be a registered user, resolved via profile

nodes.label: Testify has no custom REST API
nodes.rationale: SPA talks directly to Supabase Postgres via its auto-generated data access layer; access control enforced via Postgres Row-Level Security instead of an application server, so there is no backend server or HTTP endpoint layer to document.
nodes.norm_label: testify has no custom rest api

nodes.label: Identity split into User (private) and Profile (public)
nodes.rationale: Email addresses must never be exposed outside a user's own account; every user-facing display resolves through Profile instead of User.
nodes.norm_label: identity split into user (private) and profile (public)

nodes.label: Template vs execution history separation
nodes.rationale: Core design idea of Testify: the test template (what should be tested) and the test execution history (what actually happened) must never be confused, enabling reusable Test Cases and multiple independent Test Run histories without ever losing prior results.

nodes.label: Issue is 1-to-many against failed TestResult
nodes.rationale: A single failed test result can surface multiple unrelated problems, so issues are never forced into a strict one-to-one mapping with results.

nodes.label: Project access controlled by members list, not global account role
nodes.rationale: Global admin role is a platform-ops flag, not an access gate; per-project roles let the same user be a manager on one project and a tester on another, keeping access scoped and independent per project.
nodes.norm_label: project access controlled by members list, not global account role

nodes.label: Self-serve signup, no approval gate
nodes.rationale: First Google sign-in auto-creates a standard 'user' role account with no pending approval step, per Platform Evolution V2 Phase 2 — removing the earlier admin gate to reduce onboarding friction.

nodes.label: Two separate role systems: global account role vs per-project role
nodes.rationale: Global role (user/admin) is a platform-operations flag only, independent from and never confused with per-project roles, so a user's admin status doesn't imply project access and vice versa.
nodes.norm_label: two separate role systems: global account role vs per-project role

nodes.label: TestPlan references live TestCase, does not duplicate content
nodes.rationale: Edits to a Test Case's steps propagate immediately to every plan referencing it, while previously completed Test Runs retain their own historical record since results live on TestResult, not the Test Case.
nodes.norm_label: testplan references live testcase, does not duplicate content

nodes.label: Test Case sequencing/ordering within a Test Plan
nodes.norm_label: test case sequencing/ordering within a test plan

nodes.label: Unplanned/custom Test Run (built directly from Test Cases)
nodes.norm_label: unplanned/custom test run (built directly from test cases)

nodes.label: Progress computed live vs. Completion always manual
nodes.rationale: Progress is deliberately kept as a live computed value so it can never go stale, while completion is a deliberate manual action so a run can be closed even if not every case reached a final result.
nodes.norm_label: progress computed live vs. completion always manual
